title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
plot_overview: A young officer is killed inside a general’s home, prompting an investigation into what happened. As the inquiry unfolds, it reveals a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police, raising questions about institutional accountability and the forces that shaped the official response.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you prefer serious true-crime investigations such as The Tinder Swindler, but Not for you if you want light entertainment or a fictional mystery.
review_summary: Pros: gripping real case; institutional intrigue; investigative focus | Cons: potentially disturbing subject; heavy subject matter
